name: ItemBlueprintDefaultEnchantment - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: One default enchantment of an item blueprint, with its level. Opened by Create New Join Entry on the item blueprint form's Default enchantments step.

steps.description: Pick the enchantment and the level the item starts with. The blueprint is the one you are editing.

fields.label: Enchantment
fields.description: A vanilla or custom enchantment; each can be on a blueprint once. Create a missing one on the enchantment form first.

fields.label: Level
fields.description: Level the item starts with; for an enchantment book, the level the book teaches. Keep it between 1 and the enchantment's max level: higher levels are applied as given.
